principle_codified.name: Historical fidelity vs operationalizable references
principle_codified.rule: Preserve historical artifacts (explore.md, sketches/, archived material) unless they contain references that could cause incorrect code generation or tests. Decision rationale and reasoning preserved; specific operationalizable references (paths, signatures, names, schemas) updated when wrong.
principle_codified.future_codification_candidate: Add as a 4th cross-cutting discipline in orbit-conventions alongside read-before-reference / change-completeness / pushback — in a future change, not this one.
